items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The only reason I happened to know about it was, uh, was from old man Ramis himself... in that band, uh, they had another man who stayed here... His name was Lopez.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear any more else, anything else about that old Mexican band, your father talked about it? You know, um, um, Jack Lane says his father bought some of the old instruments and some drums from that band for him and some old flags. That's how he got started.

Well, that's, that's, that's possible, that's possible, but, uh, I don't think my dad ever, ever knew anything about that band. The only reason I happened to know about it was, uh, was from old man Ramis himself. Yeah. And that had been several years after he, he'd, uh, settled here with that band. Uh, and, and, and in that band, uh, they had another man who stayed here. Uh, uh, he was, he was, uh, the solo cornetist in this band. His name was Lopez. Oh. He was, uh, sort of on, on, uh, on the art of, uh, this,…
